identity.title: [v0.91.7][review-fix][runtime-v3] Resolve #5276 live parity and Observatory findings

values.summary: Correct proof classifications first, secure and refresh the runtime projection, replace mocked client proof with a live HTTPS lane, then reconcile and validate the full release packet.

steps.action: Audit each #5276 finding against current source and retained evidence and fix parity classification truth.
Add read authentication plus bounded weather refresh and stale-state behavior to the Runtime v3 Observatory feed.
Run the real HTML/client surface against a live HTTPS Runtime v3 endpoint and retain fail-closed proof.
Reconcile #5277-#5286 issue, PR, and check truth into the release packet and run focused/full validation.

invariants: machine-readable output and human observability remain separated
authorization fails closed without leaking secrets
parity proof never promotes a one-runtime fixture to equivalence
weather sampling remains bounded and observable
release evidence is source-linked and does not invent check results
risks: authentication changes can break the existing local demo contract
live TLS client proof can become machine-local if certificate and port handling are not portable
cross-runtime binaries may be unavailable and require truthful non-equivalence classification
release child/PR metadata may have drifted since #5276
stop_conditions: the #5412 reviewed baseline changes substantively before #5413 publication
live client proof requires committing credentials or machine-local paths
an acceptance criterion requires widening into unrelated Runtime v3 cutover work
